# Southern Edge Marketing

> Delhi and Dubai digital marketing agency: SEO, Meta and Google Ads, Shopify and Next.js websites, app development, branding and social media for Indian and UAE businesses.

## Services

- [SEO Services](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, on-page content, link building, local SEO and AI search optimization (AEO/GEO).
- [Website Development](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/services/web-development): Custom Next.js, React, Shopify and WooCommerce websites built for speed and conversion.
- [Shopify Agency Dubai](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/services/shopify-agency-dubai): Shopify store builds, migrations and conversion optimization for UAE e-commerce brands.
- [Luxury Shopify Agency UAE](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/services/luxury-shopify-agency-uae): Premium Shopify builds for luxury and fashion brands in the UAE.
- [App Development](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/services/app-development): Cross-platform and native iOS and Android apps in React Native, Flutter, Swift and Kotlin.
- [iOS App Development](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/services/ios-app-development): Native Swift apps for iPhone and iPad.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/services/social-media-management): Organic content plus paid Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok campaigns.
- [Branding](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/services/branding): Brand identity systems, logos, guidelines and creative strategy.
- [Influencer Marketing](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/services/influencer-marketing): Creator sourcing, campaign management and reporting.
- [All services](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/services): Overview of every service, including performance marketing on Meta and Google Ads.

## Proof

- [Projects and case studies](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/projects): Client work across legal services, restaurants, jewellery, fragrance and e-commerce.

## Resources

- [Blog](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/blogs): Guides on Meta Ads, Shopify, SEO, WordPress and web development, written by Ameet Nangia.
- [Mastering Meta Ads for Business](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/blogs/meta-ads-for-business-scaling-guide): Targeting, Conversions API setup, creative frameworks and budget allocation by funnel stage.
- [WooCommerce to Shopify Migration](https://www.southernedgemarketing.com/blogs/woocommerce-to-shopify-migration-services): Steps, risks and SEO preservation when moving a store to Shopify.

- Founded by Ameet Nangia
- Offices: Delhi, India and Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Serves clients in India, the UAE, the UK, the US and Australia
- Industries: legal, healthcare, SaaS, real estate, education, e-commerce, fintech and hospitality
